content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ANALYTICS(GCP Service Account Impersonation Attempt) AND ABIOC(BigQuery Table or Query Results Exfiltrated to a Foreign Project) on the same caller principal (protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail) within the run window — fuses the borrowed-identity mint (target_service_account) and the foreign-project BigQuery export (destination_project_id, foreign_project=true) into one cross-project data-exfil incident anchored to the shared caller principal (caller identity -> impersonated service account -> BigQuery job to a foreign project).
rules.name: Foreign-Project BigQuery Exfil via Impersonated Service Account — ABIOC Causality Stitch
